[[Taskmaster Bellok]] is a [[Necromancer]] [[boss]] found in [[Vloxen Excavations]].

== Locations ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Vloxen Excavations}}: Level 2

== Skills ==
(20 [[Death Magic]] in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Animate Bone Minions}}
* {{skill icon|Animate Shambling Horror}}
* {{skill icon|Death Nova}}
* {{skill icon|Deathly Swarm}}
* {{skill icon|Jagged Bones}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Signet of Lost Souls}}

== Quotes ==
: ''"Dig or die.  Your choice."''

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bellok's Staff]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
{{Bug| If a player approaches Bellok and his [[mob]], the Stone Summit and the [[Dredge]] they are guarding will turn hostile against each other. If the Dredge are killed, Bellok will continue to say his quote.}}
*If the party dies while fighting Taskmaster Bellok his group will commonly remain atop the resurrection shrine, often causing parties to fail the dungeon in Hard Mode.

==Trivia==
*Taskmaster Bellok is a reference to one of the antagonists, the Frenchman Belloq who leads an excavation camp, in [[w:Raiders of the Lost Ark|Raiders of the Lost Ark]].
